title: Quá khứ đơn: câu phủ định
learningObjectiveVi: Dùng did not cộng động từ nguyên mẫu để phủ định hành động quá khứ.
learningObjectiveEn: Use did not plus the base verb to negate past actions.

patterns: subject + did not + base verb + complement
morphologyNotes: After did not, use the base form of both regular and irregular verbs.

uses: Say that a past action did not happen.
Correct an assumption about the past.

usageConstraints: Choose the form from the intended meaning and sentence context.

rules.description: After did not, use the base form of both regular and irregular verbs.
